project_overview.mission: Multi-tenant SaaS platform converting authorized anchor portraits and Gujarati news scripts into broadcast-quality 16:9 Breaking News MP4 videos with lip-synced AI anchors, Gujarati subtitles, animated tickers, and AI disclosure labels.
project_overview.target_audience: Gujarati digital news channels, local journalists, media agencies, content creators, and broadcast studios.
project_overview.design_archetype: Editorial Command Center / Broadcast Control Room — authoritative, dark navy & charcoal aesthetics, sharp contrast, live crimson breaking-news accents, clean cards, and high data density.

data_testid_conventions.rule: Every interactive button, link, tab, input, table row, and modal MUST contain a kebab-case data-testid.

UNIVERSAL GUIDELINES FOR MAIN AGENT: Use Dark Navy (#0B0F19) and Dark Charcoal (#182232) for background and card containers. Use pure red (#EF4444 / #DC2626) exclusively for Breaking News accents, live indicators, and primary action highlights.
Import Noto Sans Gujarati & Baloo 2 from Google Fonts in index.html to render Gujarati text accurately without rendering boxes or fallback issues.
Ensure all interactive components use Shadcn/UI primitives customized with dark-mode tailwind styles.
Include explicit data-testid attributes on all interactive elements as per data_testid_conventions.
Do not build generic centered layouts or light mode default styles. Keep the theme consistently rich, high-contrast dark mode across all pages.
Maintain high contrast text: White text (#F9FAFB) for headings and inputs, Gray-300/400 (#9CA3AF) for body text.
